notes.title: Steam Fest live
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are now doing a live-streaming for The Weird Dream during Steam Next Fest. You are welcome to download the Demo from the store page and try it yourself! Oh yes, don't forget to add our game to Wishlist! 

Thank you very much!

Russian is now also supported.

notes.content:
Now available in Spanish and Portuguese!
You can select from the menu at the start.

notes.title: Major graphics enhancements! Updated to the latest demo version!
notes.content: We've just released the latest demo version with much enhanced graphics, and we invite you to play it!

notes.title: XEARZ Demo Version. Now with keyboard support!
notes.content:
Keyboard operation is now supported!
Now keyboard users can play comfortably.

notes.title: The XEARZ demo is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=orfGFH89A6s;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The demo version of XEARZ is now available! Of course you can play the demo version for free, so keep downloading and playing!

If you have any feedback or bug reports, please post them on the bulletin board on the XEARZ store page.

We will also be participating in the Steam event at TGS starting on the 16th, so stay tuned!
